name: Bonding trainer
design: Lean athletic middle-aged female Yautja, pale olive freckles, four properly jointed mandibles, broad swept-back skull and thick black scalp tendrils half tied. Moss-green fitted sleeveless workcoat over black linen, tan hip pouch, dark leather forearm guards and leg wraps. Holds a short plain wooden target wand downward in right hand and a little closed reward pouch in left. Calm open stance, training tool clearly blunt civilian, no animal.
